creator: Alexander Terp
description:
corpus/herdr-0.8.0 wire.ndjson files accumulated across runs until Recorder.append_ndjson was taught to truncate. a_29qxvebDg fixed `layout` (492 lines to 120 when four stale runs dropped out). Six others still hold several runs each:

    lifecycle        7 runs
    naming           3
    split-sides      3
    durability       2
    frame-fidelity   2
    input-encoding   2

A reader takes the file for one exchange and t_ms resets partway down with nothing saying why. The Linux corpus has none of this.

Each is one `probe <scenario>` away, but this wants checking case by case rather than a sweep: `lifecycle` and `snapshot` are what corpus/conformance/mirror.json regenerates from, so a re-record can move an oracle that cases are pinned to. a_29qxvebDg is the worked example of what that costs and how to check it - the re-record there was faithful and it still took reading every artifact to know that.

Found by slot 2 while re-recording layout, 2026-09-06.
title: Six macOS transcripts are several runs concatenated, and read as one
